jobs.tierReason: server snapshot CPU root fix; Opus review in train 7
jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: declared outputs are writable. Train 7 top priority: the installed Command Center board server burns CPU when a dashboard is open. Measured on the real 9-project board after 1.167.30 install: server CPU 0.0% with no client; 44.6% with one Command Center page open (5 s poll, 9 API calls in 45 s); /api/command-center takes 2.57 s cold, 0.01 s when repeated within the 2 s snapshot cache; /api/command-center/project 2.32 s; /api/board 1.87 s. Cause: every 5 s poll is a cache miss (2 s TTL < 5 s poll) and each build re-reads/parses all nine projects' ledgers/state/history, so a 2.5 s full build every poll.

Fix the root:
1) Profile the board snapshot build (tools/board.mjs / board-data.mjs / command-center-snapshot.mjs / watch-server.mjs). Add a per-project cache keyed by the project's ledger/state/run file identity (mtime+size or a cheap hash) so unchanged projects reuse their parsed data, plus a cache for the global history/ticket aggregates keyed the same way. Invalidate on any changed file; never serve stale data for a changed project (tests must prove a changed ticket/status shows immediately).
2) Align the Command Center snapshot cache TTL with the client poll (at least pollInterval + 1 s, e.g. 6 s) and keep ETag/304. The per-project cache is the main win; the TTL just avoids back-to-back rebuilds.
3) Fix tools/watch-perf.mjs ps time parsing: `ps -o time=` may be `m:ss.ss` or `h:mm:ss.ss` or plain seconds; parse all forms (the current parser int()s the seconds part). Keep the token redaction.
4) Add a server snapshot budget test (new tests/board-snapshot-perf.test.mjs or similar): a synthetic board with many tickets across several projects; assert the first build is bounded, an unchanged rebuild is fast (e.g. <100 ms) and a one-ticket change rebuilds correctly and only the changed project. Keep the existing watch-server/command-center tests green and the security headers unchanged. Target: with a dashboard open polling every 5 s the server stays under 5% CPU on this real board; report your measured cold/warm build times and CPU.
Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-snapshot-perf.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs tests/command-center-perf-budget.test.mjs -> all pass. Report counts and the before/after build times.
